#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <set>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdlib>

using namespace std;

// Binary search to count elements <= key in sorted vector
int binarySearchCount(const vector<int>& arr, int n, int key) {
    int left = 0, right = n - 1, count = 0;
    while (left <= right) {
        int mid = (left + right) / 2;
        if (arr[mid] <= key) {
            count = mid + 1;
            left = mid + 1;
        } else {
            right = mid - 1;
        }
    }
    return count;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, k;
    cin >> n >> k;
    vector<int> l(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        cin >> l[i];
        l[i] %= k;
    }
    if (n == 1) {
        cout << l[0] << '\n';
        return 0;
    }

    int half = n / 2;
    vector<int> l1(l.begin(), l.begin() + half);
    vector<int> l2(l.begin() + half, l.end());

    set<int> s, s1, s2;
    // First half
    for (int i = 0; i < half; ++i) {
        for (int x : s) {
            s2.insert((x + l1[i]) % k);
        }
        s.insert(l1[i]);
        for (int x : s2) {
            s.insert(x);
        }
        s2.clear();
    }

    // Second half
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)l2.size(); ++i) {
        for (int x : s1) {
            s2.insert((x + l2[i]) % k);
        }
        s1.insert(l2[i]);
        for (int x : s2) {
            s1.insert(x);
        }
        s2.clear();
    }

    vector<int> sv(s.begin(), s.end());
    vector<int> s1v(s1.begin(), s1.end());
    sort(sv.begin(), sv.end());
    sort(s1v.begin(), s1v.end());

    int ans = max(*max_element(sv.begin(), sv.end()), *max_element(s1v.begin(), s1v.end()));

    int m = s1v.size();
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)sv.size(); ++i) {
        int t = k - 1 - sv[i];
        int ind = binarySearchCount(s1v, m, t);
        if (ind > 0) {
            int r = s1v[ind - 1];
            int cand = (sv[i] + r) % k;
            if (cand > ans) ans = cand;
        }
        // also consider the largest element in s1v
        int cand2 = (sv[i] + s1v.back()) % k;
        if (cand2 > ans) ans = cand2;
    }

    cout << ans << '\n';
    return 0;
}
